note: ci: crowding as % of the station's busiest typical-week quarter-hour; si: supply as % of the line's busiest typical-week quarter-hour; cl: 0 open, 1 closed, 2 exit only (int8, -128 missing). Critical zone: ci at or above c_thr (the highest 10% of in-service station moments) and si at or below s_thr (the lowest 10%). picks: the five moments with most stations in the critical zone, per line and period. lines: lines with a disruption at that moment (severity, reason group); ctl: stations closed or exit-only (state, cause). stats: how critical station moments overall split between a disrupted line, exit-only entry and neither.
